title: Complete multi-row enumeration adds no layouts beyond the four-state two-row component
statement: A prospectively bounded exact constraint search extends the previous two-row audit to all feasible assignments involving any number of rows inside each public-page/equal-original-token-width block. It preserves every original line word multiset, each exact ordinal word multiset in the block, per-slot EVA-basic word length and frozen uncertainty/empty barriers. All210ZL and197IT blocks of the same34public practice evaluation pages were exhaustively enumerated without reaching a node, solution or storage limit. The global product contains exactly4layouts per edition, identical to the complete two-row reachable component; no feasible layout outside that component exists under these block constraints. Only8word positions and16of4796/4740adjacent pairs can vary. Thus simultaneous trades involving3+rows add no new states here. An independent row-permutation/column-count oracle matches the complete layout SET for every block, not just total counts.60random3x3cases match too. A3x3Latin fixture has12full layouts and a strictly smaller two-row component, demonstrating that the solver can detect irreducible multi-row trades. The same frozen >=100layout/>=30movable-pair gates fail, so no confirmatory p-value is reported; an exact tail on4uniform layouts cannot be below0.25. Scope is same-page/equal-token-width groups, not exchanges between pages or different row widths and not physical word spacing. This is a limitation of this conditional test, not evidence for or against language. The original PR673 hidden fact draft remains unchanged and unpublished.
check: Treat the full constrained fiber in these page/equal-width public blocks as exhausted: neither longer cycles nor a different statistic can yield a0.01uniform conditional-tail test on4states. Do not turn a mobility failure into an ESTABLISHED or REFUTED text fact. Further work needs a separately fixed larger public sample or a clearly stated relaxation of the extra equal-row-width/page blocks, with exact completeness, support and movement rechecked before inference. Retain row inventories, literal positions, lengths and barriers when claiming those are controlled. Original PR673 still requires code review/merge before its separate hidden fact can be submitted; do not change that frozen spec based on these sensitivities.

plan.question: Do trades requiring3+rows add layouts beyond the known two-row component while preserving all margins?
plan.blocks: All P rows in the same public page and same original token-count width n, as in previous diagnostics.
plan.constraints: Each original row word multiset; each (page,n,exact original k) word multiset; exact EVA-basic length at each literal slot; uncertainty/empty barriers frozen. No physical x-coordinate interpretation.
plan.method: Complete constraint search of assignments in each block, using row/column counts, positional length domains, forced placements and deterministic minimum-domain branching. Allows simultaneous trades involving any number of rows. Exact completeness is reported per block.
plan.two_row_comparison: Regenerate the exact observed component under all balanced two-row moves per block. A feasible layout outside that component is a witness that two-row moves alone cannot reach it.
plan.sample: Same34public practice evaluation pages, ZL and IT; not fresh independent pages.
plan.decision: A confirmatory-style public diagnostic is reported only if EVERY block enumeration is complete, >=100 distinct global layouts and >=30 movable adjacent pairs, with a nonconstant null. Otherwise report incomplete or insufficient, never relax constraints after outcomes.
plan.null_if_testable: 199exact uniform independent product-of-block draws, integer solution index, seed408, one-sided plus-one p<=.01 required in both editions. No MCMC mixing claim.
plan.scope: No search on heldout pages. Full fiber only within page/equal-width blocks. New unconstrained generators are not tuned to this result. No language claim from a pass.

independent_verification.method: Independent per-row permutation enumeration plus column-count join; post-primary correctness check, not a new hypothesis test.
